description: A UX change request should produce a spec with at least one 'ux' acceptance criterion.

fixture.issueBody: Add a dark mode toggle button in the top-right corner of the page. When clicked, it should switch the page to a dark color scheme (dark background, light text). The preference should persist across page reloads using localStorage. The toggle should show a sun icon in dark mode and a moon icon in light mode.

At least one acceptance criterion has verification: 'ux'
